business_summary: Suzumo Machinery Company Limited manufactures and sells food machines for small kitchens and factories worldwide. The company provides sushi machine; rice serving machine; roll sushi machine; onigiri making machine; rice cookers and mixer; rice weighing and serving machine; sushi wrapping machine; automatic roll sushi cutter and sushi making machine. It also offers rice container, Shari tray, rice-preservation sheets, rice cooking net, rice container cart, polyethylene disposable gloves, anti-fog sushi wrapping film, easy-open sushi wrapping film, lubricant oil/anti-sticking oil, and onigiri and bakery film. Suzumo Machinery Company Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.
